source: Final no-excuses verification pass — every entry below was individually confirmed by reading source/running commands, not assumed. Updated during FINALIZATION MODE to reflect the boot-topology and Hailo-runtime fixes shipped since the original pass.

issues.title: Documented systemd setup starts the safety supervisor (and perception/speech/tts/navigation) TWICE
issues.description: RESOLVED: fixed via a four-layer defense that enforces exactly one Safety Supervisor in every deployment mode WITHOUT changing the supervisor's own code -- (1) systemd Conflicts=bonbon-core.service on all 8 per-subsystem units, (2) select_deployment_mode.sh/enable_monolithic_mode.sh/enable_modular_pi_mode.sh disable the conflicting set before enabling the chosen mode, (3) the static classify_topology() validator (devops/scripts/boot_topology.py, run via scripts/validate_boot_topology.py) exits non-zero on a duplicate/missing supervisor, (4) scripts/check_duplicate_ros_nodes.sh checks the live ros2 node list count. 12 tests in devops/tests/test_boot_topology.py cover monolithic-valid, modular-valid, mixed-invalid, and duplicate-supervisor-detection. See docs/BOOT_TOPOLOGY_FIX_REPORT.md and docs/SAFETY_SUPERVISOR_SINGLETON_POLICY.md. Live confirmation on a booted Pi (systemctl is-active, ros2 node list) remains BLOCKED without physical hardware -- see docs/FINAL_PRODUCTION_READINESS_CHECKLIST.md.

issues.title: No Hailo AI HAT acceleration -- vision inference runs on the Pi CPU
issues.description: RESOLVED (backend implemented and tested without hardware; on-device run remains BLOCKED without a real AI HAT): new bonbon_ai_runtime package adds an optional, lazy-imported HailoRuntime alongside the existing CPU/TensorRT paths, selected via RuntimeSelector(auto|hailo|cpu|tensorrt|mock) which prefers Hailo when truly available and otherwise falls back with an honestly-reported reason -- never a fake Hailo PASS. 27 unit tests plus 6 hardware-gated tests (3 SKIP off real hardware with a stated BLOCKED reason, 3 no-fake-PASS guards run everywhere). The bonbon_vision._build_detector() adapter wiring RuntimeSelector into vision_node is the documented next integration step (see docs/HAILO_RUNTIME_INTEGRATION_REPORT.md, docs/AI_HAT_RUNTIME_STRATEGY.md); it does not block the runtime abstraction itself being real, tested, and dashboard-visible.

issues.title: bonbon_vision test suite cannot run in this dev environment
issues.description: Re-verified 2026-07-01: no longer literally hangs, but tests/test_vision_node.py and tests/integration/test_vision_integration.py now fail at COLLECTION with `ImportError: cannot import name 'PerceptionBudget' from 'bonbon_msgs.msg'` -- vision_node.py imports a message type that only exists after a real `colcon build` generates bonbon_msgs' interfaces, which this non-ROS2-sourced dev environment cannot do. Not this session's work to fix (requires a sourced ROS2 workspace to even attempt); tracked as a hardware/build-environment-gated item, not something the pure-Python suites can resolve.

issues.title: 7 of 11 dashboard commands have no real ROS2 backend
issues.description: emergency_stop (hardware/GPIO e-stop only, no software trigger exists anywhere), pause, resume, restart_module, get_config, set_config, memory_query, rag_query (LLMQuery.srv is defined but bonbon_llm never serves it) all honestly report unavailable rather than fake success. navigate, cancel_task, dock, and speak ARE wired to real services/topics.

issues.title: bonbon_perception is intentionally quarantined
issues.description: Superseded by bonbon_vision + bonbon_gesture + bonbon_affective_ai. Launch file disabled, entry_points emptied, documented in its own README. Source kept for reference, not deleted. Correctly marked, not a defect.

issues.title: ExecuteMotionSequence.action is defined but has zero consumers
issues.description: No action server or client exists anywhere in the codebase for this interface. Either a planned capability never implemented, or dead weight to remove.

issues.title: 20 of 26 packages have no real-ROS2 CI coverage
issues.description: CI's colcon test --packages-select only covers bonbon_safety, bonbon_hal, bonbon_operator_api, bonbon_data_stores, bonbon_simulation, bonbon_bringup against a real sourced ROS2 install. The rest are only exercised via pure-Python rclpy-stub tests, which cannot catch real message-type/topic-name mismatches (exactly the class of bug found and fixed in the dashboard bridge this pass).

issues.title: 5 modules use raw sqlite3.connect() instead of the canonical SQLiteConnection wrapper
issues.description: bonbon_data_stores/backup_manager.py, bonbon_operator_api's audit_logger.py and auth_manager.py, bonbon_perception_ai's structured_store.py, and bonbon_safety's incident_logger.py each manage their own SQLite connection independently. Each solves a genuinely different problem (backup, audit, auth, perception memory, incident log) — not redundant pipelines duplicating the same job — but a DRY opportunity, not a blocker.

issues.title: bonbon_operator_api's test suite takes 2-12 minutes vs <2s for every other package
issues.description: Likely real network/sleep-based waits inside FastAPI TestClient + websocket tests. Not a failure, worth a follow-up investigation for test-suite health.

issues.title: ai_core/, top-level simulation/, tools/ were empty, untracked skeleton directories
issues.description: Removed during this verification pass — confirmed zero files anywhere in their trees and zero git history (git ls-files returned 0 for all three) before removal.

issues.title: 7 ROS2 interfaces existed on disk but were never registered for code generation
issues.description: NavigateTo.srv, CancelNavigation.srv, GetNearestCharger.srv (bonbon_srvs) and NavigationStatus.msg, NavigationGoal.msg, DockingStatus.msg, RecoveryStatus.msg (bonbon_msgs) were imported by bonbon_navigation's own code but missing from their CMakeLists.txt rosidl_generate_interfaces() calls — would have failed any real colcon build independent of anything else. Fixed during this verification pass.

issues.title: Dashboard ROS2 bridge was subscribed to topics/types matching no real publisher
issues.description: 0 of 8 original subscriptions had both the correct topic name AND correct message type. Rewired to real SafetyState, BatteryState, NavigationStatus, ActuationStatus, PersonTrack, ResourceUsage, PerceptionEfficiencyMetrics, and curated ModuleHealth topics. Fixed during this verification pass.
